target: Make the reviewed-module hash check in the site registry independent of checkout line endings without changing any receipt bytes, and record a portable, append-only normalization of every mapped receipt.

searched_existing: website/scripts/book_registry.py receipt and module hash binding
reuse_plan.decision_reason: No Lean declaration is added or changed. The change is a publication-gate portability fix: receipt hashes recorded from one checkout's mixed line endings could not be reproduced on any clean LF or CRLF checkout, so build_site.py failed with 'topic reviewed module hash drift' outside that machine.

truth_boundary: Receipt values remain those recorded at review time; the normalization record documents that each recorded value is the LF, CRLF or raw-working-tree rendering of content byte-identical to the committed blob at the same commit, with the raw case attested from a read-only second checkout. Root-file entries (BanditRLProof.lean, Tests.lean, website/scripts/build_site.py) in historical validation receipts legitimately drifted as the roots grew; they are not consulted by the registry and are not rebound. No theorem, review verdict, topic status, main merge or deployment is changed.

focused_checks: Supporting non-protected files in the same change: tools/verify_review_receipt_hashes.py (portable verifier), tools/test_book_registry.py (two new regression tests), runs/extended-topics-20260921/topic-receipt-hash-normalization.json (append-only normalization record bound by sha256 from the five reviewed topic mappings)

python tools/verify_review_receipt_hashes.py over all fifteen mapped receipts with --also-checkout of the Codex worktree at the same commit: every registry-consulted module entry bound (LF, CRLF, or attested raw rendering); exit 1 only for historical root-file entries not used by the registry

python -m unittest tools.test_book_registry: 17 tests OK on a pure-CRLF checkout, including the new rendering-tolerance and content-bound tests; before the change 12 of 17 failed with 'topic reviewed module hash drift'

Codex integration at initial HEAD 05dbb1cd624f9d1d0b0bcb930c62636cdb200a29 preserves explicit production_hashes_lf validation and current causal rebinding; legacy mappings use portable matching. A path-specific .gitattributes LF rule keeps the new normalization record byte-identical to its bound Git blob. Local registry tests: 20/20 passed. Local historical 15-receipt verifier exits 1 only for historical root/build-script drift; detailed independent local results follow in runs/extended-topics-20260921/receipt-portability-local-validation.json.

Codex Linux-blob preflight found every mapped receipt SHA bound to CRLF rendering. Registry now accepts exact raw/LF/CRLF renderings of the receipt and normalization-record JSON itself, without parsing/reserializing to obtain a hash. Existing rendering regression covers both Lean and runs JSON under LF and CRLF; all 20 tests pass. Receipt bytes and SHA fields are untouched.

PR contributor-contract run 35567794343 passed. Duplicate branch-push run 35567796533 failed because it compared the last push rather than the integration base and treated earlier chain coverage as stale. Non-main push/workflow-dispatch now uses origin/main, while PR, merge-group and main-push retain their event-specific base. The full integration diff is still checked; no gate is skipped.
